Udacity Scones Unlimited project using a fictional delivery company scenario.

A confidence-aware image classification workflow

A serverless workflow that routes image-classification results through a confidence check.

Amazon SageMaker · AWS Lambda · Step Functions · Python

The question

A prediction workflow needs to respond sensibly when model confidence is too low.

The work

  • Prepare bicycle and motorcycle image data and train a SageMaker classifier.
  • Connect preprocessing and inference with Lambda and Step Functions.
  • Apply a confidence threshold and inspect recent inference results.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Notebook contains saved confidence-monitoring plots and example inference outputs.

What I learned

  • Build evaluation and failure handling into orchestration rather than treating inference as a single call.

Project context

  • Teaching prototype and low-resolution course images; no real delivery operation claimed.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
